summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of 'The Book of Everything'. 30/30 pytest backend tests pass (stats, validation, books, chapters, propositions, search/filters/pagination, random, graph, changes, audit, register/login/me, Ask the Book grounded + refusal, personal library CRUD, challenges, editorial summary/list/decision/revise/retract, and 403 forbidden for reader on editorial). Frontend flows verified via Playwright: homepage renders live stats (12/144/1000/2526 citations) and non-infallibility statement; /read shows 12 book cards; book -> chapter -> reader flow works with Simple/Scholar controls; Explorer search returns results; Map of Everything renders both knowledge graph and accessible table; Editorial dashboard reachable after admin login and shows pending challenge queue with approve/reject actions; Ask the Book returns grounded answer containing [P#] citations.

minor.issue: Cookie is preferred over Authorization header. When both are present (e.g. after previous login left a cookie), the cookie wins and Bearer is ignored. Standard practice is to prefer explicit Authorization header. Not blocking but caused initial test flakiness with shared sessions.
Not itself an issue but note: endpoint correctly requires auth (401 for anonymous); confirmed.

ui_bugs.issue: No catch-all/404 route defined. Unmatched paths (e.g. /books, /read/1 where '1' is not a valid slug, /chapters/1) render only the Layout header/footer with an empty body and no user feedback.
Spec references data-testid="reader-mode-toggle" but the reader uses separate Simple/Scholar buttons without that testid. Functionality works but automated selectors from the spec do not match.
Review request expected slug 'mahakali-corpus' but actual seeded book slugs are 'origins','matter','life',... (12 books). API works; only the spec expectation is stale.

issues: Blank content area on unmatched routes provides no navigation cue; add a NotFound component

action_items: Add a catch-all Route path='*' returning a NotFound page (currently /books, /read/<invalid>, etc. render only header/footer).
Either add data-testid='reader-mode-toggle' to the Simple/Scholar controls, or update spec to point at the individual buttons.
(Optional) In auth._extract_token, prefer the Authorization Bearer header over the cookie so API clients aren't silently overridden by a stale cookie.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~660 lines and mixes models, seeding, and 25+ endpoints. Consider splitting into routers (auth, corpus, propositions, editorial, library, ask) for maintainability (>700-line threshold approaching).
The /ask endpoint returns 502 if emergentintegrations raises; consider a graceful degraded response with grounding hits so the UI can still display evidence when the LLM is momentarily unavailable.
Cookies are set with secure=true, samesite=none which is correct for the cross-site preview host; confirmed working. bcrypt hashes verified starting with $2b$ via successful login flow.
Frontend `Books.jsx` uses `b.reading_minutes` and `b.concepts` etc. without null-safety; would crash if API schema drifts. Non-blocking for current sample corpus.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows working; minor missing 404 route and testid mismatch)

test_credentials: Admin: editor@mahakali.org / Codex2026!  |  Reader: reader@example.com / reader123 (both verified working)
seed_data_creation: None (backend self-seeds 12 books / 144 chapters / 1000 propositions and both users on startup). Test suite creates ephemeral challenges/notes/bookmarks and one register user per run; not cleaned up but scoped by unique user ids.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py under /app/backend/tests uses fresh requests.Session per test (session cookies leaking between admin+reader logins caused false failures earlier because backend prefers cookie over Bearer). Book slugs are 'origins','matter','life','pattern','time','language','society','value','knowledge','mind','continuity','book' — not 'mahakali-corpus'. Frontend uses /read routes, not /books. Reader Simple/Scholar are separate buttons, no combined toggle testid. Ask the Book relies on Mongo text-index; nonsense queries return grounded=false as designed.
rca of the issue: Missing catch-all route: React Router v6 without a Route path='*' silently renders no element inside <Routes> for unmatched paths, leaving only the surrounding <Layout> visible. Reproduce: visit /books or /read/1 -> empty page. Mitigation: add <Route path='*' element={<NotFound />} /> in App.js.
